credits.title: A Lei
credits.overview: Soldiers from the Military Police stand at the counter of a decadent diner, where they can eat greasy food without paying the bill. When they discuss their violent job in one of the biggest cities in the world, they make it clear who, in the name of the law, is allowed to commit the most hideous crimes.

credits.title: The Inside
credits.overview: This is the story of Perci, a boy who quarantines himself in a small kitchenette in downtown São Paulo. When you receive an order, your daily life becomes an exercise of approaching, moving and looking, for yourself and for the other.

credits.title: Top 10 Places to Visit in São Paulo
credits.overview: On a Sunday, two photographers walk around São Paulo trying to connect with the city, and slowly fall in love with each other.
